text.id: Tanggul Pluit. Setahun yang lalu.
text.en: The Pluit seawall. A year ago.

text.id: Dari atas sini, Jakarta kelihatan kayak orang yang lagi nahan napas.{w} Gedung-gedung nyala di belakang, laut hitam di depan, dan tembok beton di tengah-tengahnya.
text.en: From up here, Jakarta looks like it's holding its breath.{w} Towers lit up behind us, black sea in front, and a concrete wall in between.

text.id: Sekar duduk di atas tembok itu, kaki menggantung ke sisi laut, seolah jatuh itu sesuatu yang cuma terjadi ke orang lain.
text.en: Sekar sits on top of that wall, legs dangling over the sea side, like falling is something that only happens to other people.

text.id: Gue berdiri di belakangnya, megangin dua gelas es teh plastik yang udah mulai keringetan.
text.en: I'm standing behind her, holding two plastic cups of iced tea that have started to sweat.

text.id: Dengerin dulu. Serius, dengerin sampai habis, baru boleh ngeledek.
text.en: Just listen. Seriously, hear the whole thing first, then you can make fun of me.

text.id: Gue belum ngomong apa-apa.
text.en: I haven't said anything.

text.id: Muka lo udah ngomong dari tadi, Ka.
text.en: Your face has been talking the whole time, Ka.

text.id: Muka gue emang begini dari lahir.
text.en: My face has looked like this since birth.

text.id: Iya, dan dari lahir juga lo nyebelin.
text.en: Yeah, and you've been annoying since birth too.

text.id: Gue naik ke tembok dan duduk di sebelahnya, agak jauh dari pinggir. Gue nggak pernah suka ketinggian. Dia tahu, makanya dia selalu ngajak ke sini.
text.en: I climb up and sit next to her, a little further from the edge. I've never liked heights. She knows, which is why she always drags me here.

text.id: Kita kenal dari SMA. Dia yang pertama nyapa, di hari pertama, karena gue satu-satunya anak yang bawa headphone segede helm.
text.en: We met in high school. She talked to me first, on the first day, because I was the only kid with headphones the size of a helmet.

text.id: Lima tahun kemudian, dia punya podcast dengan dua ratus pendengar, dan gue tukang edit suaranya yang nggak pernah dibayar.
text.en: Five years later, she has a podcast with two hundred listeners, and I'm the unpaid guy who cleans up its audio.

text.id: Sekar nyenggol bahu lo.
text.en: Sekar bumps your shoulder.

text.id: "Oke. Gue dengerin."
text.en: "Okay. I'm listening."

text.id: "Dua ratus pendengar, Kar. Sembilan puluhnya bokap lo."
text.en: "Two hundred listeners, Kar. Ninety of them are your dad."

text.id: Bokap gue cuma satu orang, ya. Walaupun dia punya tiga akun.
text.en: My dad is one person, thank you. Even if he has three accounts.

text.id: Tumben. Catet tanggalnya.
text.en: That's a first. Write down the date.

text.id: Dia nyodorin HP-nya. Di layar, gelombang suara dari rekaman yang dia ambil sore tadi di Muara Angke.
text.en: She holds out her phone. On the screen, the waveform of a recording she made this afternoon in Muara Angke.

text.id: Pak Karta. Nelayan, udah tiga puluh tahun melaut dari dermaga yang sama. Katanya, dulu dari sini sampai Pulau Pari airnya masih bisa buat ngaca.
text.en: Pak Karta. A fisherman, thirty years out of the same pier. He says that from here to Pulau Pari, the water used to be clear enough to see your face in.

text.id: Sekarang ada patok-patok di tengah laut. Ada yang bilang itu buat pulau baru. Nggak ada yang pernah nanya ke nelayan.
text.en: Now there are stakes driven into the open water. Some people say it's for a new island. Nobody ever asked the fishermen.

text.id: Terus?
text.en: And?

text.id: Terus gue mau bikin satu episode penuh soal itu. Bukan obrolan santai kayak biasanya. Yang beneran. Wawancara, data, peta.
text.en: And I want to do a whole episode on it. Not the usual chill chat. A real one. Interviews, data, maps.

text.id: Dan gue butuh orang yang bisa ngedit audio tanpa bikin suara angin kayak pesawat jatuh.
text.en: And I need someone who can edit audio without making the wind sound like a plane crash.

text.id: Dia nengok ke gue. Matanya nyala kayak tiap kali dia nemu ide yang terlalu besar buat dia sendiri.
text.en: She turns to look at me. Her eyes light up the way they always do when she finds an idea too big for one person.

text.id: Sabtu ini. Jam lima pagi, di dermaga Muara Angke. Kapalnya Pak Karta berangkat jam setengah enam. Lo ikut, kan?
text.en: This Saturday. Five in the morning, at the Muara Angke pier. Pak Karta's boat leaves at five thirty. You're coming, right?

text.id: Ini saatnya ngomong. Gue udah nunda dua minggu.
text.en: This is when I tell her. I've put it off for two weeks.

text.id: Kar.{w} Gue keterima kerja. Di Bandung.
text.en: Kar.{w} I got a job. In Bandung.

text.id: ...Oh. Wah. Itu bagus, kan? Kapan mulai?
text.en: ...Oh. Wow. That's good, right? When do you start?

text.id: Senin. Gue berangkat Minggu pagi.
text.en: Monday. I leave Sunday morning.

text.id: Minggu ini?
text.en: This Sunday?

text.id: Iya.
text.en: Yeah.

text.id: Lo udah tahu dari kapan?
text.en: How long have you known?

text.id: Gue nggak jawab. Itu udah jawaban.
text.en: I don't answer. That's an answer.

text.id: Dua minggu? Tiga? Kita ketemu tiap hari, Ka. Tiap. Hari.
text.en: Two weeks? Three? We see each other every day, Ka. Every. Day.

text.id: Ya karena gue tahu bakal kayak gini.
text.en: Because I knew it would go like this.

text.id: Kayak gimana? Gue nanya, lo jawab. Itu namanya ngobrol.
text.en: Like what? I ask, you answer. That's called talking.

text.id: Lo selalu gitu. Kalau ada yang berat, lo diem, terus tiba-tiba lo udah pergi. Kayak waktu bokap lo. Kayak waktu kuliah.
text.en: You always do this. When something gets heavy, you go quiet, and then suddenly you're gone. Like with your dad. Like with college.

text.id: Jangan bawa-bawa bokap gue.
text.en: Leave my dad out of this.

text.id: Oke. Terus Sabtu? Lo masih bisa ikut Sabtu. Satu hari. Abis itu lo bebas ke mana aja.
text.en: Fine. So, Saturday? You can still come on Saturday. One day. Then you can go wherever you want.

text.id: Sekar nungguin jawaban.
text.en: Sekar is waiting for an answer.

text.id: "Lo bukan jurnalis, Kar. Lo cuma punya mic."
text.en: "You're not a journalist, Kar. You just own a mic."

text.id: "Nggak semua orang bisa hidup dari mimpi."
text.en: "Not everyone gets to live on dreams."

text.id: (Nggak usah jawab.)
text.en: (Don't answer.)

text.id: Wow. Oke. Seenggaknya sekarang gue tahu lo mikir apa selama ini.
text.en: Wow. Okay. At least now I know what you've been thinking all this time.

text.id: Mimpi. Iya. Pak Karta juga mimpi, kali ya. Mimpi lautnya balik.
text.en: Dreams. Right. I guess Pak Karta's dreaming too. Dreaming his sea comes back.

text.id: Tuh kan. Diem lagi.
text.en: See? Quiet again.

text.id: Dia turun dari tembok, ngambil tasnya, dan jalan ke arah motor tanpa nengok.
text.en: She climbs down from the wall, grabs her bag and walks toward her scooter without looking back.

text.id: Dua gelas es teh masih di tangan gue. Esnya udah cair semua.
text.en: Both cups of iced tea are still in my hands. The ice has all melted.

text.id: Gue bisa ngejar dia. Gue tahu persis harus ngomong apa.{w} Gue nggak ngejar.
text.en: I could go after her. I know exactly what to say.{w} I don't go.
